sources.population: IMF World Economic Outlook LP via DataMapper, Oct 2026 vintage (millions converted to persons; World Bank unavailable)
sources.fx_rate: ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates via Frankfurter (annual average of daily rates, LCU per USD)

fx_definition: Annual average units of local currency per 1 US dollar (calendar-year basis, Dec 31 year-end convention)
news_note: 2-3 major geopolitical events per year, editorial selection, one-line summaries
sport_note: One notable sporting event per year involving the country, editorial selection

geopolitical_news.headline: John Key takes over National leadership
geopolitical_news.summary: Don Brash resigned in November and former currency trader John Key was elected leader unopposed.

geopolitical_news.headline: New Zealand troops join Timor-Leste force
geopolitical_news.summary: Defence personnel deployed to Dili as communal violence destabilised the young nation.

sport.headline: All Blacks complete unbeaten Grand Slam tour
sport.summary: New Zealand swept England, France, Scotland and Wales on the end-of-year northern tour.

geopolitical_news.headline: Police launch Urewera 'terror' raids
geopolitical_news.summary: October raids in the central North Island led to firearms charges and a heated political debate.

geopolitical_news.headline: Electoral Finance Act passed amid protests
geopolitical_news.summary: Labour pushed the controversial campaign finance law through in December despite opposition outcry.

sport.headline: All Blacks stunned by France at World Cup
sport.summary: A quarter-final defeat in Cardiff ended New Zealand's 2007 World Cup campaign in shock.

geopolitical_news.headline: John Key's National wins election
geopolitical_news.summary: National defeated Labour in November, ending nine years of Helen Clark's government.

geopolitical_news.headline: Sir Edmund Hillary dies aged 88
geopolitical_news.summary: The Everest conqueror and Antarctic explorer died in January, prompting a state funeral.

sport.headline: Rowers and cyclists lead Beijing medal haul
sport.summary: New Zealand won nine medals at the Beijing Olympics, including three golds.

geopolitical_news.headline: Auckland 'super city' reforms legislated
geopolitical_news.summary: Parliament merged the region's councils into a single Auckland Council from 2010.

geopolitical_news.headline: Recession deepens as unemployment climbs
geopolitical_news.summary: Joblessness hit decade highs as the global financial crisis dragged New Zealand through recession.

sport.headline: Black Caps reach Champions Trophy final
sport.summary: New Zealand lost to Australia in the Centurion final of the one-day tournament.

geopolitical_news.headline: Pike River explosion kills 29 miners
geopolitical_news.summary: The November blast on the West Coast became one of New Zealand's worst industrial disasters.

geopolitical_news.headline: Canterbury earthquake damages Christchurch
geopolitical_news.summary: A powerful September quake struck near Darfield, wrecking buildings but causing no deaths.

geopolitical_news.headline: National's popularity holds amid recovery
geopolitical_news.summary: John Key's government maintained strong polling as the economy slowly emerged from recession.

sport.headline: All Blacks complete unbeaten northern tour
sport.summary: New Zealand won every Test on the end-of-year tour of Britain, Ireland and France.

geopolitical_news.headline: Christchurch earthquake kills 185
geopolitical_news.summary: The February quake devastated the city centre, becoming New Zealand's deadliest peacetime disaster.

geopolitical_news.headline: Rena grounding causes worst oil spill
geopolitical_news.summary: The container ship struck a reef off Tauranga in October, spilling oil onto Bay of Plenty beaches.

sport.headline: All Blacks win home Rugby World Cup
sport.summary: New Zealand edged France 8-7 in the Auckland final to lift the Webb Ellis Cup.

geopolitical_news.headline: Kim Dotcom arrested in FBI-backed raid
geopolitical_news.summary: The internet mogul was arrested at his Auckland mansion in January over copyright charges.

geopolitical_news.headline: Partial sale of state power companies begins
geopolitical_news.summary: The government pressed ahead with asset sales despite opposition and a citizens' referendum.

sport.headline: Lisa Carrington wins kayak gold in London
sport.summary: The 23-year-old won the K1 200m, New Zealand's standout gold of the London Olympics.

geopolitical_news.headline: Same-sex marriage legalised
geopolitical_news.summary: Parliament passed marriage equality in April after a conscience vote and public gallery celebrations.

geopolitical_news.headline: GCSB spying bill passes amid protests
geopolitical_news.summary: Expanded surveillance powers for the spy agency were legislated despite privacy concerns.

sport.headline: Team NZ loses America's Cup after 8-1 lead
sport.summary: Oracle Team USA completed a stunning comeback in San Francisco to retain the Cup.

geopolitical_news.headline: National wins third term under Key
geopolitical_news.summary: John Key's party secured a commanding September victory, its third consecutive election win.

geopolitical_news.headline: Internet Party-MANA alliance flops
geopolitical_news.summary: Kim Dotcom's big-spending election vehicle failed to win a single seat.

sport.headline: McCullum hits NZ's first Test triple century
sport.summary: Brendon McCullum's 302 against India in Wellington rescued a famous draw.

geopolitical_news.headline: Trans-Pacific Partnership concluded
geopolitical_news.summary: Twelve nations including New Zealand finalised the huge trade deal in Atlanta in October.

geopolitical_news.headline: Flag referendum process begins
geopolitical_news.summary: Voters were asked to choose a new flag design in the first of two referendums.

sport.headline: All Blacks win back-to-back World Cups
sport.summary: New Zealand beat Australia in the London final, the first team to defend the title.

geopolitical_news.headline: John Key resigns; Bill English takes over
geopolitical_news.summary: Key's shock December resignation made deputy Bill English prime minister.

geopolitical_news.headline: Kaikoura earthquake strikes
geopolitical_news.summary: The November quake killed two and severed road and rail links along the east coast.

sport.headline: Rio brings record 18 Olympic medals
sport.summary: New Zealand won four golds among a record medal haul at the Rio Games.

geopolitical_news.headline: Jacinda Ardern becomes prime minister
geopolitical_news.summary: Labour formed a government with NZ First in October after Ardern's meteoric campaign.

geopolitical_news.headline: Edgecumbe floods force evacuations
geopolitical_news.summary: Autumn floods inundated the Bay of Plenty town, displacing hundreds of residents.

sport.headline: Team New Zealand wins the America's Cup
sport.summary: The Kiwis swept Oracle in Bermuda to reclaim sailing's biggest prize.

geopolitical_news.headline: Ardern gives birth while in office
geopolitical_news.summary: The prime minister had a daughter in June, a first for a New Zealand leader.

geopolitical_news.headline: Government bans new offshore oil exploration
geopolitical_news.summary: No new exploration permits would be granted, a landmark climate policy decision.

sport.headline: Black Ferns Sevens win world title
sport.summary: New Zealand's women claimed the Sevens World Cup in San Francisco.

geopolitical_news.headline: Christchurch mosque shootings kill 51
geopolitical_news.summary: A gunman attacked two mosques in March in New Zealand's worst modern mass shooting.

geopolitical_news.headline: Parliament passes sweeping gun reforms
geopolitical_news.summary: Military-style semi-automatics were banned within weeks of the Christchurch attacks.

geopolitical_news.headline: Whakaari eruption kills 22
geopolitical_news.summary: The December volcanic eruption on White Island killed tourists and guides.

sport.headline: Black Caps lose World Cup final on boundary count
sport.summary: England won the Lord's final on a tiebreak rule after a tied Super Over.

geopolitical_news.headline: Elimination strategy drives hard lockdowns
geopolitical_news.summary: New Zealand pursued zero-COVID with strict lockdowns and closed borders.

geopolitical_news.headline: Labour wins historic outright majority
geopolitical_news.summary: Ardern's party won the October election outright, a first under MMP.

sport.headline: Crusaders win debut Super Rugby Aotearoa
sport.summary: The Christchurch side took out the domestic competition created during the pandemic.

geopolitical_news.headline: Trans-Tasman bubble opens then bursts
geopolitical_news.summary: Quarantine-free travel with Australia launched in April but collapsed amid Delta outbreaks.

geopolitical_news.headline: Team NZ retains America's Cup in Auckland
geopolitical_news.summary: The defenders beat Luna Rossa in March to keep the Auld Mug.

sport.headline: Black Caps win World Test Championship
sport.summary: New Zealand beat India in the Southampton final to become inaugural Test champions.

geopolitical_news.headline: Parliament protest ends in riot
geopolitical_news.summary: The three-week occupation of parliament grounds was cleared in March amid fires and clashes.

geopolitical_news.headline: Borders reopen after two years
geopolitical_news.summary: New Zealand lifted COVID border restrictions in stages from May.

sport.headline: Black Ferns win home Rugby World Cup
sport.summary: New Zealand beat England in the Auckland final before a record crowd.

geopolitical_news.headline: Cyclone Gabrielle devastates North Island
geopolitical_news.summary: The February cyclone caused deaths and massive damage across Hawke's Bay and Tairawhiti.

geopolitical_news.headline: Labour loses; Luxon becomes PM
geopolitical_news.summary: National won the October election and Christopher Luxon formed a coalition government.

sport.headline: Football Ferns co-host Women's World Cup
sport.summary: New Zealand staged the tournament with Australia but exited in the group stage.

geopolitical_news.headline: Mass hikoi protests Treaty Principles Bill
geopolitical_news.summary: Tens of thousands marched to parliament in November opposing the controversial bill.

geopolitical_news.headline: Government pushes through tax and spending cuts
geopolitical_news.summary: The coalition delivered tax relief while cutting public sector jobs.

sport.headline: Paris Olympics brings record 20 medals
sport.summary: New Zealand won ten golds, its most successful Olympic Games ever.

geopolitical_news.headline: Parliament kills Treaty Principles Bill
geopolitical_news.summary: The bill was defeated at second reading in April after record public submissions.

geopolitical_news.headline: Cook Islands-China deal strains NZ ties
geopolitical_news.summary: The Cook Islands' partnership agreement with Beijing tested its constitutional relationship with Wellington.

sport.headline: All Blacks rebuild under new coaching era
sport.summary: New Zealand's rugby side worked through a transitional season with mixed results.
